test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A can complete {3over 5} part of a work in 12 days. B can complete {2over 3} parts of the same work in 8 days. In how many days will A and B together complete the work?
solution:
**Formula:**

Efficiency = Total work ÷ Time taken to complete the work individually.

**Calculation:**

Time in which A can complete the work individually = 12over {3over5} = 12 × 5over3 = 20 days

Time in which B can complete the work individually = 8over {2over3}<span style=&
